text: Aeron Leifbrand was a Cormyrean Wizard of War who served in the town of Eveningstar in the late 15 century DR.

Master Aelioth, sometimes misspelled as Aeolith, was an ambitious Red Wizard and necromancer of Thay, who served Valindra Shadowmantle during her mission to the Dragonbone Vale of the Sword Mountains in the late 15 century DR.
Aerbront was an accomplished wizard living in Daerlun in Sembia in the mid–14 century DR.
Akhlaur was a powerful conjurer and necromancer who lived in Halruaa during the mid–12 century DR.
Alban was a wight and the ruler of the city Mictlatepec in Maztica.
Alain was an ancient elf who came to study the magic associated with the bulette creatures inside the Darkmoon temple, but became trapped by his own device.
Alcedor Kolat () was a powerful mage who lived in Waterdeep in the 14 century DR.
Alatian was the apprentice of a reclusive lich and arcane researcher Estera, sometime before 1372 DR.
Alamarayne Moonray was a priestess of Selûne residing in Elmwood. She assisted Dorn Graybrook and Karasendrieth in repelling the Zhentilar that occupied her village in the .
Al-Nasr, which was Midani for the Vulture, was a mysterious ajami necromancer who inhabited the city of Hilm in the Pantheist League of interior Zakhara during the mid–14 century DR.
Aphril was a seer and an inmate of the Spellhold asylum in 1369 DR.

Arachhar Sevenstar was a wizard and a member of the Zhentarim. He served as a mageling to Ruatheene and was based in a Zhentilar camp in the valley of Arntethyl by the river Tesh. Arachhar was a genius boy from Yhaunn, known for his talent in creating new spells and his frequent episodes of insanity.
Arkaneus Silvermane was the Archdruid of Mosstone and a member of the Company of Eight in Tethyr in the 14 century DR.
Arcanali was a very old drow wizard in Battledale in 1357 DR.
Archadamius Luciard was an elven merchant and wizard from Westgate.
Asha the Silent was a wolf and later human who became High Moonmistress of Moonshadow Hall in Yhaunn during the 8 century DR. She was known for never speaking during her time at Moonshadow Hall.
Armeld was a War Wizard of Cormyr in the late 14 century DR.
Asblan, who was nicknamed the Bold, was a powerful wizard who once inhabited Ordulin in Sembia during the early 14 century DR.
Armbraddon was a powerful wizard living in Iriaebor in the Western Heartlands in the mid–14 century DR.
Aulmpiter was a nycaloth and a member of the Trio Nefarious and leader of the Army of Darkness that assaulted Myth Drannor in the early 8 century DR.

Avaereene was a lich and a former human wizard who was one of the most trusted agents of the Xanathar, the leader of the Xanathar Thieves' Guild of Skullport. She oversaw the guild's slavery operations.

Aurora (), sometimes called Aurora the Eclectic, was a human wizard, a former adventurer, and the owner of the Aurora's Emporium chain of stores in the mid-to-late 14 century DR. Her business supplied a wide variety of products and adventuring gear.

Aubayreer was a historically important wizard, having served as the high mage and later ruled as the Mage-king of Aglarond. He began a magical dynasty that continued on to the reign of the Simbul, the Witch-Queen of Aglarond.
Asp was a spirit naga assistant of the Zulkir of Alteration, Maligor in Amruthar in Thay circa 1362 DR.
Astragarl Hornwood was a renowned Mage of Elembar, who lived in the 2 century DR.
Asshurat was a skilled wizard inhabiting the city of Messemprar in Unther during the mid–14 century DR.

Arathur Harpell was a wizard from Longsaddle in the Savage Frontier and a member of the Harpell family. He was for a time in possession of Orjalun's Arbatel, a powerful magic book made from mithril. Arathur was killed in a duel by Marune, a necromancer who took the Arbatel for himself.

Babaus () also known as 1-horned horrors or ebony deaths, were a type of tanar'ri demon that served both as assassins and recruiters. They possessed a devilish deceptiveness, combined with demonic bloodlust.
Avelyere, most often referred to as Lady Avelyere, was a diviner who ran a school (Coven) for young sorceresses in the Shade Enclave in 1469 DR.
Baerithryn, also known as Braer, was an elf wizard who tutored the young Elminster Aumar.
Baeloth Barrityl, also known as Baeloth the Entertainer, was a powerful drow sorcerer and the master of the Black Pits, a famous fighting pit located in the Underdark.
Azuah al-Jawwaf was a powerful sorcerer and member of the court who lived in Wasat in 1367 DR.
Aziza al-Nayyir was a half-elven mystic and a fabled Dome Dancer in Zakhara around 1367 DR.
Baden was a Netherese archwizard and a scholar who worked in Karsus Enclave.
Azundel was a moon elven wizard from Ordulin, known for creating the spell Azundel's purification.
Azaltin Ibn Issad was a powerful sorcerer who ruled the city of Al-Anwahr during the 5 century DR.
Azibar, who was nicknamed Azibar of the Seven Skulls, was a vile wizard apprentice who inhabited the city of Waterdeep during the 1350's DR.
Bagshaw was a Netherese arcanist who worked at the Mythomian Warehouse in Eileanar until its destruction in .

Azruss Drevontir was a former Candlekeep scholar who had formed an infernal pact with the balor Errtu in the late 15 century DR. He would later become a reluctant adventurer, traveling as part of the Battlemarked Heroes after they had saved him from a ritual gone awry.
A baazuled was a walking corpse that was animated by means of binding a demon into it rather than through normal necromancy. They were created via a ritual known to Nar demonbinders.
Barcero was a shadovar wizard from Sembia in the late 15 century DR.
Baranta Chansil was a human wizard of Elturel in the Western Heartlands in the mid–14 century DR.
Baluu was a pangolin katanga sorcerer from the jungles of the Malatran Plateau active in the late 14 century DR.
Balineth Skroun, was a Zulkir of Conjuration sometime circa late 1300 DR.
Basil of Lyndusfarne was an unusual verbeeg in the service of the Kingdom of Hartsvale in the 1370s DR. He was a runecaster, a rarity among his people.
Bashshar al Rachid was a famous collector, merchant, and the wealthiest djinni on Toril in the early 14 century DR.
Bayard was a Netherese animal trainer who worked in Karsus Enclave until its destruction in .
Begoas the Inquisitive was a handsome human necromancer from the Old Empires region and the first Minister of Necromancy in the city of Ravens Bluff's Ministry of Art in the 14 century DR.
Belak the Outcast was a dark druid allegedly exiled from his druidic circle for reasons unknown. He took up residence in the Sunless Citadel in order to study the Gulthias Tree.
Belpheron (or Balpheron) was an ancient and powerful lich who once tried to destroy Faerûn. He was the mentor of Heurodis.
Belargh Thulin was a male wizard who was one of the magelords of Athalantar and was killed by Elminster Aumar early in his insurrection.
Belkram was an insane undead dwarf of Clan Melairkyn inside Undermountain in 1375 DR.
Bensozia, the Queen of Hell, was an archdevil and consort of Asmodeus.

Benelaius was a War Wizard of Cormyr who retired in the mid–14 century DR. In 1366 DR, he moved to the village of Ghars, on the edge of the Vast Swamp, and bought a small house abutting the swamp. He lived there with his servant Jasper and a large number of house cats.
Berthot was a Netherese arcanist and spell inventor that lived during the Age of Discovery.
Benauril was an outcast wizard from Halruaa who was active circa the mid-to-late 12 century DR. He was notable for creating the creatures known as dark trees.
Beltar Whitewave was a War Wizard of Cormyr in the mid–15 century DR.
A Bhaalspawn, sometimes called a child of Bhaal, was a mortal offspring of the dead god Bhaal.
Black Garius was a powerful archmage of Luskan and a member of the city's sinister ruling cabal, the Arcane Brotherhood.

The Black Leopard, also known as Bauhei and Hei Te Pao, and titled the Great Cat and the Most Feline Master, was an ancient greater spirit in Kara-Tur. He was the at-times unwilling patron of the notorious Black Leopard Cult.

Bishimzon was the human wizard in charge of the Cult of the Dragon's operation set from the ruined Darnarest's tower, somewhere in the Interior Faerûn. His main activities circa 1369 DR were capturing unwitting villagers and adventurers to be used as the Cult's slaved in the city of Myth Drannor.
Bigby was a legendary otherworldly wizard and hands-on spell inventor. He was known by several inhabitants of the Realms, and a handful of his spells were used all over.
Bias was a corrupt Netherese arcanist who served as an Underchief at Constabulary Branch Two in Eileanar before its destruction in .
A bloodkiss beholder was a kind of undead vampiric beholder whose eyestalks had mutated into mouths that allowed it to drain the blood of its victims.
A blood golem was a horrific golem fashioned from the coagulated blood of beings sacrificed to dark gods by evil priests and intended to deliver death and destruction to their foes.
Blood elementals were creatures summoned form the life-giving liquid – blood, known to be exceedingly rare outside the Domains of Dread.
Blaskyn was the apprentice of Laeral Rythkyn in the mid-14 century DR. He betrayed her to get at Thalon's Throne, but the artifact instead rendered him into the lich's host.
Boddyknock Glinckle was a gnome sorcerer from Lantan in the late 14 century DR who was present in Neverwinter during the Wailing Death and may have been an associate of the Hero of Neverwinter.

Bodaks, () meaning the unfinished dead in the language of lesser tanar'ri demons, were what was left of a humanoid that had been destroyed by the touch of pure evil, such as that of a nightwalker. Undead creatures devoid of personality or souls, bodaks were cruel and relentless hunters, either of their own volition or at the behest of some greater power, such as the nightwalker that created them.

Bog hags were vile, swamp-dwelling hags, heinous crones that preyed on humans. They stole the flesh of their victims to hide their hideous forms, using their hides as an appealing, skin-deep disguise.
Bolifar Geldert was a War Wizard of Cormyr. He went missing in , from a chamber which once belonged to Amedahast.
Bonehoof was an undead skeleton minotaur in Myth Drannor during the late 14 century DR.
Boeddu was a human druid, adventurer, and planeswalker of the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Brazhal Kos was a powerful enchanter and a member of the Red Wizards of Thay during the 14 century DR.
Brant Hallower was a werewolf servant of Selûne and member of the New Moon Pact in the 8 century DR.
Bowsar Ostramarr was a War Wizard of Cormyr in the late 14 century DR.
Bralliel was a warlock who was known for inventing Planar Bidings for the fiends of the Nine Hells sometime long before the late 15 century DR.
Brown Maeve was the Royal Magister of Ankhapur and the former wizard of Pinch's thieves guild.
Bryan the Bold was a vassal of Edenvale in the Utter East, as well as a bloodforge mage during the time of the Bloodforge Wars (648–657 DR).
Briosar Helmsing was a high priest ranger of Mielikki in the 14 century DR.

Broalaunt was a Thayan cursed by Samaerra, an apprentice of Larloch, to become a boar after he became too familiar with her at a Magefair. He had to achieve a series of unbindings by performing great tasks; such as eating thirteen rabid chipmunks, and kissing the Simbul, among others. As a boar he was known as Warpig, and his companion was a half-orc named Orokh.
Bruk was a human invocation wizard and adventurer of the Puppetmasters company in 1369 DR.

Caladnei () was the Royal Mage of the Cormyrian court, replacing Vangerdahast after his retirement. She was renowned for her feisty and opinionated personality and was often seen as hard to deal with in the Court. Caladnei was also the leader of the famed War Wizards.
Callabus was a goblin wizard who attacked the Ten Towns for the Legion of the Chimera.
Buoyance was a Netherese arcanist who became a lich in 3000 NY.
Calathlarra was a Runemaster of the Twisted Rune in the late 15 century DR.
Caldor Raventree was a War Wizard of Cormyr in the late 15 century DR.
Caligarde was a mage who studied the arcane arts under the Seven Wizards of Myth Drannor, survived the fall of the city and went on to become a spell inventor of note.

Caligrostos were a type of loumara (disembodied demonic spirits) that possessed bladed weapons to fulfill their bloodlust. The sadistic shades compelled their wielders to seek out new victims, which their current wielders could easily become.
Caddelyn was a powerful wizard and the author of Caddelyn's Workbook.
Burgel was an apprentice Red Wizard of Thay in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Carolyas Idogyr was a half-elf sorcerer of the Idogyr clan from Waterdeep.
Cassana was a centuries-old evil wizard who worked with the Fire Knives, the Iron Throne, and masterminded the creation of Alias for her own ends.

The cat lord (also rendered as Cat Lord), also known as master cat, was one of the Animal Lords. The cat lord was the ruler of all felines, from the common house cat to the huge smilodon. Those who truly understand felines know that the Cat Lord is neither good nor evil but concerned with cat-things alone. To this end, he roams various planes, including the Material Plane.
Canumbrax was a shadurakul (shadow canomorph) bounty hunter in 1374 DR.
Chancil Crystalheart was a human mage of Memnon in Calimshan in the 1350s DR.
Chadwick was a wizard who lived in Waterdeep in late 15th century DR.
Centeol was a cursed woman whose body was transformed by the elven mage, Jon Irenicus.

Cathliira was a female human wizard living in Elturel in the Western Heartlands in the 14 century DR. She was an apprentice of Kappiyan Flurmastyr of Waterdeep and was a notable sorceress and accomplished mage before the 1360s DR.
Chansrin Aluar was a female human wizard who lived in Scornubel in the 14 century DR.

Chevesh was a powerful human wizard who liveed in a marble tower in Airspur. He was widely regarded by the citizens of Airspur to be crazy and most people avoided his tower. Chevesh was suspected of summoning demons and was investigated by Demascus. However, the investigation cleared him of demonic associations. Chevesh would have liked nothing more than to be a firesoul genasi and was researching methods to turn humans into firesouls. His tower was guarded by an azer.
Chaumyk Vorn was a male human Red Wizard and khazark of the Thayan enclave in Hillsfar.
Chantlarn Iyrmerr was a male wizard who was one of the magelords of Athalantar and was killed in Elminster Aumar's insurrection.

Cheg was a doppelganger member of the Unseen who disguised itself as the human Nool, a Hand Leader and a member of the Xanathar Thieves' Guild of Skullport in 1370 DR. As Nool, he guided a squad of ten slavers in search of victims in Waterdeep's slums and using his peculiar talents they usually had a good hunt. As Cheg, his mission was to get near the Xanathar and discover his lair, in order for the Unseen to control him from afar and possibly assassinate the Xanathar at need.
Chaspra was a skilled enchanter who lived in Selgaunt in 1358 DR.
A chaos quadrapod was a horror from the Far Realm. The creature was bent on spreading the disruptive energy from that plane and on causing destruction everywhere it went.
Colderan Morn was a male human wizard and once a tyrannical Mage-lord of Daggerdale. He was also the great-grandfather of the famous Randal Morn.
Daisake Mayazato was a wu jen in the town of Aru in Wa in the late 1350s DR.
Daffir the Prescient was a human member of the College of Divination in the city of Sshamath.
Cyndre was a Thayan wizard living in Caer Callidyrr during the mid–14 century DR. He was the leader of the sinister Council of Seven.

Curnetheres was a mage and member of the Wraith of the Inner Sea privateer fleet in the mid–14 century DR. He was outlawed from Luthcheq in Chessenta because of the city's persecution of mages, and joined the company in order to have revenge. Circa 1357 DR, Curnetheres was the highest-ranked mage on the Sea Horse.
Czarnieck was a skilled Netherese arcanist who taught at the Academy of Mentalist Study in Eileanar shortly before its destruction in .
Daikon was a wizard with the Arcane Brotherhood of Luskan in the late 14 century DR.
Daer'Ragh's aura cleansing was an arcane spell that allowed the caster to cast spells back to back.

A dark tree was an evil intelligent tree that looked like a cypress tree, but slightly darker and devoid of moss. It was known to grapple and bite. It lived on drinking blood from humans and other intelligent creatures that wandered into its native jungle.
The Darkmask was a special divine caster of Vhaeraun. They were considered the elite among the Vhaeraunan clergy.

Dardren was a wizard from Memnon in Calimshan, of the 13th century DR. Dardren was slain by Glaragama Dunrohiyr, a rogue archmage who'd disguised herself as a man. When she killed Dardren, she revealed her true form, then stole all his magic.
The Dark Eight was a coven of pit fiend generals who resided on Nessus, the ninth layer of the Nine Hells. They plotted and strategized the movements of Hell's armies.
Darcassan the Farseer was a male sun elf diviner of Windsong Tower.
Dalthoeneir Delthoenoth was a male moon elf wilder and a younger member of the Kaliesh'erai, an association of psionic elves in Evereska.
The Dark-Eyed One was an adventurer and mage in the ruin of Spellgard.
Darnarest the Bladesmith was a competent wizard and a smith who specialized in creating enchanted weapons. The wizard was slain by the vengeful red dragon Kezzanamark in 1303 DR.

Dallah Thaun was the dark twin of Yondalla, who acted from the shadows to protect and avenge halflings, as well as to help them towards prosperity and mischief. She was also responsible for guiding the souls of halflings to the afterlife. As an aspect of Yondalla, she was both separate yet the same being, and her existence was kept utterly secret from those outside of the halfling community.
Darrake Harnwood was a War Wizard of Cormyr until the late 15 century DR.
Dark Moon monks were monks who followed the ways taught by the Order of the Dark Moon.

Deathcalm the Loved helped to run Galvendo's Lodge with her companion and business partner Galvendo, of whom the lodge was named. She assisted in such ways as raising clients who had met their end on hunting trips with Galvendo.
Darsson Spellmaker, known commonly as Darsson, was a renowned Halruaan wizard who specialized in researching new and wondrous spells.
Darthleene was an archlich shopkeeper in Berdusk in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
A deathstalker, also known as a deathstalker of Bhaal, was a servant of the once Lord of Murder, Bhaal.
Lady Decampus, who became known as the Singing Lady, was a Netherese arcanist and a bard who developed the alarm spell.
Daver was a runecaster in Volkumburgh Vale between the 12 and 14 centuries DR.
Death shepherds were powerful undead creatures that led groups of the risen dead.
Deathslayers were a variety of wizards that honed their skills in the Art for the narrow goal of seeking out and destroying all manner of undead.
Dead Urzakka the Unrested was an undead orcish gladiator and one of the pain-bringers of the Slaughterhouse Arena of Tyraturos, Thay, at the very end of the 15 century DR.
Delthrin Everet, also known as Delthrin the Deadmaster was a human man of the city of Marsember in Cormyr. He was a necromancer and local hero.
The archmage Demron was the creator of the Baneblades of Demron, six powerful magical swords created before the fall of Myth Drannor.

Demodands (), also known as gehreleths () or nicknamed leths, were said to have been fashioned by one of the baernoloths. They were the primal creations of evil and implacable forces of destruction, exiled to Carceri for their chaotic taint and the self-appointed wardens of their fellow prisoners within the Tarterian Depths. It was said that demodands combined the worst traits of both demons and daemons.
Deepspawn () were monstrous aberrations that could birth many other varieties of monsters, known as their "spawn."
Degrodel was an wizard specializing in the school of abjuration who lived in the city of Baldur's Gate in the mid–14 century DR.
Deniak was a splinter Cult of the Dragon leader and spellcaster and the brother of Delina.
Demchungchumrub was a lich conjurer who inhabited the Many-Windowed Tower on the shore of the Yal Tengri in the Hordelands in the mid–14 century DR.
Delfen Ondabarl, known also by the nickname of "Yellowknife", was the greatest wizard of Daggerford and a teacher at the Sorceller's Encapsulate as of the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Deirex Jae'llat was a powerful drow lich who founded the city of Ust Natha.
Dendar the Night Serpent was an elder evil and a primordial.
Derek was a skeleton warrior captain of the guard who dwelled in the Accursed Tower of Icewind Dale, doomed to unlife by a dying curse of a priest of Myrkul.

Delphaeryn Leiyraghon was a necromancer of House Leiyraghon of Melvaunt in the Moonsea and a senior member within the Cult of the Dragon in the late 14 century DR. She was one of the Wearers of Purple who had a seat on the six-person council that led the Cult cell based in Wyrmsmoke Keep in the Galena Mountains.
Lucklady Demetria Fortunato was the High Priest of Tymora in Tymora's Holy Hall of Good Fortune and Casino in the Foreign Quarter of Zhentil Keep in the .
Delavaundar was a member of the War Wizards of Cormyr, active in the mid 14 century DR.
Deelin was a dwarf wizard who lived in Neverwinter during the late 14 century DR.
Madame Delores was a gypsy bard and soothsayer from the city of Ravens Bluff in the late 14 century DR.

Huntmistress Dhusarra yr Fadila el Abhuk was a Calishite human vampire (formerly an adventurer) who lived in Undermountain and worshiped Malar. She famously conducted a High Hunt in the city of Waterdeep. Dhusarra's former master was Noreyth Harpell.
Dire corbies were a mutated semi-humanoid horrors that were once birds.
Deularla "Hightower" Ithruen was a gold elf wizard and adventurer from Evermeet who resided in Cormyr in 1367 DR.
Detrinius Wands was a Faerunian lich in T'u Lung in 1358 DR.
Diarbekir was a skilled necromancer who inhabited the city of Ysawis before its fall.
Dhadius the Scarlet was a human wizard of the Arcane Brotherhood in the late 15 century DR.
Dili was an inmate who was held within the Spellhold asylum in the . She was unique in that she was not imprisoned for her mental instability, but rather her unique magical talents.
Dethed the Death Lich was a Netherese arcanist and lich who formulated several death-based spells.
Devanto was a diviner and one of three minor wizards stationed at the enclave run by the young Red Wizard Hinnar.
Dillencraft was a Netherese arcanist who was the Dean of Teachers at the Institute for Sorcerous Imagery in Karsus Enclave until its destruction in .
Devonshire was a Netherese animal trainer who worked in Karsus Enclave until its destruction in .
Diyab was a divine spellcaster and devotee of the Bhaalspawn Sarevok who lived in the Realms during the mid−14 century DR.
Domino was a yuan-ti pureblood illusionist who was a servant of Esau Enoch in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.

Dorigen Kel Lamond was an evil wizard in service to Castle Trinity in the Snowflake Mountains in the mid–14 century DR. She took part in the attack against Shilmista and caused much ruin to the elves. But after Cadderly Bonaduce spared her, she gradually underwent a change of heart, ultimately sacrificing herself at the Edificant Library in an attempt to save her new-found friends from vampires.

Dosemen, sometimes called Dosemen of Sundabar, was a competent wizard from Sundabar. In 1364, he was involved in a contest with the fellow mages of his guild and invoked the aid of a demon. Dosemen was tricked into calling the help of a powerful demon lord, Errtu. When Errtu was invoked, the demon lord destroyed the container's spell with a piece of dead-magic zone and killed the mage.

Drago Dreadloch was a bloodforge mage in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars (648–657 DR). Drago was supported via the Great Sea and was a strong foe of the leader of the Legendary Campaign. Snatching a surprise opportunity, the Legendary Campaign leader established a foothold on the Realm of Tides, and used it as base to strike at Drago in bloodforge battle.
Dragomir the Red was a power-hungry vampire warlord who commanded armies both in life and during undeath.
Dostrealt was a drow wizard and captain of the flitter Erevan's Clutch.

The dragonkiller was the name given to an enigmatic evil human who beheaded dragons across North Faerûn to complete a ritual to summon the tarrasque. His plans, and the tarrasque, were defeated by the crew of the Realms Master and Murilantilathenes of the Dragon Congress.
Dreveth the Gray was a male human diviner who resided in Hillsfar and would occasionally help adventurers.
Dralas was an undead human warrior and assassin from Thay in the late 15 century DR. He was a servant of Szass Tam and Sofina of the Red Wizards of Thay.
Durnibas Uxyndar was a skilled drow arcanist during the 1480s DR.
Durilghar Szind was a drow necromancer of House Szind from Sschindylryn in the late 15 century DR.
Lady Doctor Ellandra Tolbert was a noblewoman and a famous necromancer-anatomist from the city of Waterdeep in the 14 century DR.
Elthenhelm Hastyl was a truenamer. He led the House of the Unnamed academy in the late 15 century DR.
Essarlym the Black was a male human necromancer and leader of a Cult of the Dragon cell in the city of Elversult.
Faelas Xorlarrin was a drow wizard of House Xorlarrin in Menzoberranzan in the late 15 century DR.
Fahren was a Netherese arcanist who developed spells that affected the sight of others.
"Fadlimi" was a doppelganger assassin working for the Sons of Gondegal bandit gang in Cormyr in the late 1370s DR.
Ezmerelda d'Avenir, born under the surname Radanavich and preferring to be known by the nickname Ez, was a hunter of monsters (often vampires) who traveled across the Domains of Dread.
Falataer was a powerful bard, musician, and instrument maker from the Moonshae Isles, famed for creating the original Instruments of the Bards of Toril.

Fastrin the Delver was a powerful wizard and the benevolent ruler of an ancient kingdom in the Sunrise Mountains in East Faerûn, who went mad after uncovering an ancient artifact. He ruled the kingdom for a time during the age of Netheril, prior to the Dale Reckoning.
Farideh () was a tiefling warlock who accidentally made a pact with the cambion Lorcan. She was the adopted daughter of a dragonborn warrior named Mehen and the twin sister of Havilar.
The Farseer was the second most powerful diviner of Faerûn in 1372 DR.
Fareeansis was a balor who taught Jesanta Beril about demonbinding in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
A feral spirit was a beastmaster ranger who had become so closely bonded to their beast companion as to transcend mundane connection and to be seemingly of one mind.
Filani of Tantras was a female human wizard and sage from the city of Tantras who settled in Tilverton in the mid-14 century DR.
Filzaur was a male drow wizard and a student of the Inverted Tower in Szith Morcane.
Fimbrul devils were soldiers of the Nine Hells that were said to sap the very life from the flesh of the living.

Fiirfar Nulomn was a human magic-user and a member of the adventuring company known as The Four. He was hanged as an assassin in Tethyr on the day before Higharvestide in 1369 DR following the siege of Myratma, along with fellow members Telorn and Diloule "Lanternhand".
Fitzmilliyun Sparkledrim was a mighty gnome illusionist who lived centuries before the 14 century DR, when Ascalhorn was in its prime.
Firemanes, also called Lights of the Lion's Mane, were specialty priests devoted to Nobanion, the King of Lions.
Flaugergues was a powerful Netherese arcanist who taught at the Academy of Mentalist Study in Eileanar shortly before its destruction in .
Flammos Galdekund was a stooped, pox-marked stout merchant, married to Aglarra Galdekund. The couple lived in Waterdeep until, in 1369 DR, Alaphondar assumed Flammos's identity and appearance.

Forsaken shells were a type of undead consisting of a full set of skin that had been removed from the body of a slain or still-living creature. These undead could arise from almost any type of living creature, so long as it had skin, even dragons or giants. While sometimes created by necromancers, they could otherwise arise spontaneously from a corpse with the influence of necrotic energy or be created by the deliberate workings of another forsaken shell.

A frenzy dog was a magical transformation of almost any other animal, created by the special create frenzy dog spell used by the druids of the Chondalwood to protect their environment. The spell that created these creatures was barely known outside this forest, and the druids used it sparingly, creating a pack of only around a dozen frenzy dogs at one time, wary of their ability to ruin forest environments if left unchecked. A frenzy dog gained a certain amount of magical intelligence, but only enough for hunting.
A fundamental was a tiny creature composed of pure elemental energy.
G'axir the Seer was a fortune teller and diviner who lived in Baldur's Gate during the mid–14 century DR.
Frederick Maxillian was the member of the Maxillian werewolf who resided in Daggerford's Western Farmlands circa 1272 DR.
Funglesby was a beast master thug who opposed the The Guild crime gang of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
The Decimator is a character featured in Call of Duty: Vanguard Zombies mode. It is a deity of the Dark Aether and a former commander of the Night Legions.
Vercanna, also known as Vercanna the Last, is a character mentioned in Call of Duty: Vanguard Zombies mode. She is a deity of the Dark Aether and the last survivor of the Wilds of the Dark Aether.
Abelazar is a Redguard necromancer who resides at the Rahni'Za, School of Warriors in the region of Craglorn.

Aelif is a Khajiit and a member of the Fighters Guild. She likes to fight Daedra and occasionally practices necromancy. She is the secret main antagonist of the Fighters Guild questline as she later reveals herself to be an agent of Molag Bal after her failed attempt at getting guildmaster Sees-All-Colors killed.
Adras Velae is a Chimer spirit sealed away underneath Heimlyn Keep in Stonefalls. He is one of two Chimer mages that created the spellplague. In addition, he was a worshiper of Namira.
Adept Tendren is a Dunmer mage and a member of House Telvanni residing in Sadrith Mora, in Vvardenfell. She can be found in Tel Naga's Adepts' Hall and will attack the trespassing Vestige on sight.

Affairs of a Wizard is a quest in . The Hero is to kill a powerful necromancer named Celedaen, who is attempting to transform himself into a lich. The orders recommend that the Hero attempts to discover a weakness before taking him on.
Alasan is a Redguard necromancer residing in the city of Tava's Blessing, Alik'r Desert. After the ward is destroyed he becomes Alasan's Soul.
Aldimion is an Altmer vampire acting as an agent of the Order of the Black Worm in Daggerfall, Davon's Watch or Vulkhel Guard, depending on the Vestige's alliance.

Alval Uvani is a Dunmer battlemage who travels throughout Cyrodiil supposedly to do business. He maintains a home in Leyawiin that he uses when he returns home. But during the week he can be found in Bravil, Skingrad, and Bruma. Alval is extremely hostile towards anybody who attempts to speak with him, threatening to attack them with Destruction magic. He suffers from a rare allergy to honey, so he must avoid foods like mead or be paralyzed.
Alyssa is a deceased Breton conjurer, whose body can be found in the Dire Warren in the Shivering Isles.
Aluvus is an Altmer vampire found at the Ayleid ruin of Ondil, Auridon.
Alois Bielle is a Breton vampire located in Grayhome, the former base of operations of the Gray Host, in .

Anchorite Garmar is a Nord and a member of the Worm Cult. He is the one responsible behind the recent appearance of reanimated bodies in Riften, using the washed-up corpses from Lake Honrich as the source.

Anirne is an Altmer Sorcerer residing in Sud along with Gorenea Andrano, on the island of Sheogorad. It is implied she is a former member of the Mages Guild; although the reason behind her leaving is not clarified, it can be assumed it was because of her ties with necromancy and with Daedra. Anirne is hostile and will attack on sight.
Anexiel is a powerful spider daedra in who settled in the Nilata Ruins in Bangkorai. With her powers, she drew travelers to her lair to absorb their souls.

Anui-El, also known as Anuiel, and Aniel, and not to be confused with Auri-El, is a deity of the Aldmeri Pantheon that is the representation of everlasting ineffable light as well as the soul of all living things. Anui-El is the soul of Anu, and in turn Auri-El is the soul of Anui-El. Anui-El is also known to be the opposite force to Sithis, just as Anu is the opposite force of Padomay.

Ansei Satameh is the mother of twins, Ra Hasa, and Ra Huzar. She was known as Tigress of Dragonstar. When the Vestige went to The Valley of Blades ancestral crypt in Hammefell to find the Amulet of Kings, Mannimarco raised Ansei Satameh's skeleton to stop the Vestige.

Arentus Falvius is an Imperial sorcerer and the primate of the Bruma Chapel of Talos. He calls it his mission to show Bruma's Nords the path to the true faith, claiming that they must put aside their heathen gods and worship the Nine Divines.

The Argonian Shaman is an Argonian enemy inside Veyond Cave. There are four variants, two male and two female. They are dressed in a simple grey robe or monk robe and carries a leveled and sometimes an enchanted dagger, as well as being a spellcaster.

Arngeir is a powerful elderly Nordic Greybeard who serves as the instructor and mentor in the Way of the Voice for the Dragonborn and others, like Ulfric Stormcloak. He also serves as a general spokesman for the Greybeards since the others cannot speak without using the Thu'um. He and his fellow Greybeards live at High Hrothgar. He can be found meditating in one of the wings of High Hrothgar, sleeping in the bedroom at the western end of High Hrothgar, or in the High Hrothgar Courtyard behind the building.

Armiger Rhina is a powerful reanimated corpse found in Tu'whacca's Throne. Rhina was an Armiger in the Order of Diagna who died in the final days of the Siege of Orsinium. She was born in a siege camp there and spent her entire 26 years fighting the Orcs. It is said that it was her sacrifice that brought victory.

Artisan Lenarmen is an Altmer scholar found in Nchuleftingth on Vvardenfell. He stole Neramo's Dwemer control rod, and is using it to find what he thinks is the Heart of Lorkhan. He summons Dwarven automatons in combat.

Aspiring Mage is a Nord in that is encountered during a random encounter called College Application Denied. He is usually surrounded by dead wolves and will be trying unsuccessfully to bring one of them back to life. He can also be found dead next to a vigilant of Stendarr or a bandit.

In most of the districts of Valenwood, Baan Dar, or The Bandit God is a less important god than the others of the Bosmeri Pantheon. He is a trickster spirit of thieves and beggars. In Elsweyr he is one of the more important gods, and is considered one of the Pariah. As a Pariah, Baan Dar becomes the cleverness and desperate genius of the long suffering Khajiiti, whose last minute plans always upset the evil plans of their Elven or Nedic enemies. The Five Finger Dance is Baan Dar's realm of worship. Worshipers of Baan Dar go to Thormar in Reaper's March to play pranks on each other in order to the be accepted into the Five Finger Dance. He is known as the Bandit God there. The First Scroll of
Azra Nightwielder is a mage who lived in a small village of Azra's Crossing during the War of Bend'r-Mahk. He is best known for being a pioneer of Shadow Magic.

Baladas Demnevanni is a well-versed Dunmer House Telvanni Sorcerer and Councilman who resides near the outskirts of Gnisis. He maintains a pet Daedroth, several skeletons, a couple of rats, and a Centurion Sphere as guardians of his home. He is involved in a number of quests (including two of which he gives himself).
Baeralorn is a necromancer who serves as Court Wizard to Anvil Castle. He is an Associate of the Mages Guild.
Barilzar is an undead Lich found in the Abandoned Crypt of Old Mournhold. He is the creator and holder of Barilzar's Mazed Band, a ring that possesses great power.
Bashnag is an Orsimer spellsword in who leads the group of necromancers inside Southfringe Sanctum.
Baron Wylon Montclair is a powerful Breton vampire trying to forcefully gain control of Rivenspire. He serves as the region's main antagonist.

Baroness Leila Montclair was the wife of the now-vampire Baron Wylon Montclair. She died when her husband tried to cure her illness via the Lightless Remnant, a powerful Ayleid relic found atop The Doomcrag. Instead, it turned her into a bloodfiend and was slain by Count Verandis Ravenwatch.
Baron Thirsk is a grievous twilight boss in . He may be found patrolling the Nobles District. He can summon Banekin through Daedric Arches.
Battlemage Gaston is the Breton leader of a contingent of Lion Guard soldiers trying to contain a Daedra that was summoned by the Bonesnap Goblin Tribe.
Bertrand Landreau is a Breton mage found throughout Tamriel during a random encounter. He can be seen leaving a portal, saying his quote and entering the portal again. He cannot be interacted with.
Bleak Veil Aggrandizer is a skeleton necromancer in Bahraha's Gloom.
Bolor Savel is a Dunmer and a necromancer who joined the Order of the Black Worm under Mannimarco.

The Boatman is a unique undead creature found at the end of The Spine. He will take Cyrus to and from the Isle of N'Gasta for a fee of 3 . The Boatman appears to be part of his boat, and uses a long paddle to travel across the sea.

The Camoran Usurper was a member of the Camoran Dynasty. Haymon Camoran, as he was originally known (although also later known by such names as Hart-King, and Camoran Hart-King), served as Sorcerer and Advisor to Camoran Kaltos, a military leader and tactician of Valenwood. Haymon, in league with Kaltos and Kaltos' Chief Scout, Orben Elmlock, began their usurpation in 3E 249. He quickly and violently freed the Bosmer from the Empire, taking two years to do so, and then proceeded northward. After the destruction of one of the first conquered cities, Kvatch, Kaltos plead with Haymon to end the madness and return to Valenwood. Haymon turned on Kaltos, forcing Kaltos to flee for his life. Haymon
Captain Blackheart is a powerful undead pirate captain found at the end of the Blackheart Haven. He leads the Blackheart Haven Pirates. A copy of him is also found in the Infinite Archive.
Captain Blanchete is an undead Breton pirate captain found with his dead crew on the Wreck of the Raptor, Auridon. He is accompanied by the Ghost Vipers, and his pet monkey, Hardtack.

Caranya is an Altmer necromancer. Since she has the rank of Master Wizard, she is part of the Council of Mages along with Hannibal Traven, Raminus Polus, and Irlav Jarol. However, she has not renounced her necromantic affiliation, despite Arch-Mage Traven's ban on necromancy within the guild. She resided at the Arcane University until taking the Necromancer's Amulet to Fort Ontus.
Captain Ralimbar is an undead skeleton found at Castle Rilis in Auridon.
Celedaen is an Altmer and powerful necromancer found in Leafrot Cave. He is trying to change himself into a Lich.

Celemaril Light-Bringer, also known as the Celemaril the Great, and also known by his title of the Sorcerer-King was an Ayleid ruler and necromancer in the First Era. During the Fourth Era he escaped his tomb in his new Lich form. He is the main antagonist of .

Clavicus Vile (Daedric script: ), also known as the child-god of the Morningstar, Master of Insidious Wishes, the Prince of Bargains, and the Consumate Politician of Oblivion, is one of the seventeen Daedric Princes. He is best known for granting wishes and entering into pacts with mortals. He is the Daedric Prince of Power, Trickery, Wishes, Serenity, and Bargains. His plane of Oblivion is known as The Fields of Regret.

Claudie Themond is a deceased Breton in Glenumbra. She haunts Baelborne Rock ruins so Athel Baelborne cannot take over his estate after his father. She was betrayed by his father and thus made a deal with a Daedra so her son could live.

Colleen is a member of the Dragonstar Mages Guild that held the title of Mage Guildmaster Pro-Term until the end of the War of Bend'r-Mahk. She initiates the Soul of Conflict into the Mages Guild after they paid the one-time fee of 750 .

Crowborne Horror is a named Wraith-of-Crows that appears during the Witches Festival. It can be found in its own pocket realm of Evergloam, Garden of Shadows. To enter its realm, a crowborne horror effigy is crafted and imbued with energy to open a portal at Olyve's Brewery. During the fight it summons skeletons, wailing wraiths and ominous gravestones, which in turn summon zombies.

Danel Telleno is a Dunmer mage, and a member of the Mages Guild. He may be located at several cities during the Mages Guild questline, those being Davon's Watch, Daggerfall, and Vulkhel Guard. He may even be found in the Foundation's Rising marketplace of Vivec City, where he is speaking to Millenith, standing in a corner in the city's Mages Guildhall, or in the hall in Rimmen. He is a professor, and may improve the Vestige's level on various crafting skills.
